hypothesis: Changing only the WKB retarded phase and coefficient target rotation from travel to travel+t0 will materially improve same-medium unseen-source generalization over r23 after the same 1000 updates, because source onset no longer has to be learned as a frequency-dependent coefficient phase.
expected_mechanism: For a linear acoustic source, a time shift t0 multiplies every Fourier bin by a known phase. Including t0 in the fixed retarded-time basis removes this nuisance phase exactly and should disproportionately improve layered held-out sources with large t0 shifts and small spatial displacements.
literature_basis: The frequency/arrival decomposition follows the Helmholtz-operator evidence map; the onset term is fixed source metadata and uses the Fourier shift theorem rather than a learned or label-derived statistic.

single_conceptual_variable.name: wkb_source_onset_phase
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: r20 update-2600 initialization, group-aware fit/calibration/confirmation panels, 96-bin gated model, all trainable parameters, loss, optimizer, learning rates, seed, update budget and metric

panels.calibration_truth_access: fixed 32-frame checkpoint selection followed by one all-saved report
panels.confirmation_truth_access: opened once at all saved times after checkpoint freeze

primary_metric: relative reduction versus r23 in all-saved calibration and confirmation aggregate relative L2

acceptance.strong_source_gate: all fit, calibration and confirmation aggregate/family relative L2 <= 0.10

failure_signal: Reject onset alignment if fit remains above 0.50 or either calibration/confirmation aggregate improves by less than 20% relative to r23. Any non-finite update, OOM, panel overlap, missing binding or peak CUDA above 4 GiB also rejects.
rollback: Preserve r20-r25 artifacts. On failure disable the optional onset flag and reject further WKB source-phase tuning; move to an explicit source-centered spatial operator or the coarse-propagator residual priority.
